headline: Flock Safety Cameras, police shooting statistics, and contractor/developer compliance with city ordinances top the new business agenda.
summary: The committee will take up new business on Lawrence Police Department Flock Safety Cameras, shooting statistics and public safety technology, and contractor and developer compliance with city ordinances and permit requirements. The agenda also lists dozens of previously tabled items dating from 2013 through 2026 covering topics such as snow and parking rules, speed limits, police and fire reports, and other public safety concerns.
